statement: USCIS communicates a request for evidence (RFE) or notice of intent to deny (NOID) by regular or electronic mail, specifying the evidence required or the bases for the proposed denial and indicating the response deadline; the maximum response period for an RFE cannot exceed twelve weeks, the maximum response time for a NOID cannot exceed thirty days, and additional time to respond may not be granted (8 CFR § 103.2(b)(8)(iii)-(iv)).
caveat: The notice's own printed deadline controls and is often shorter than the regulatory maximum; USCIS may deny without first issuing an RFE or NOID where the record establishes ineligibility (8 CFR 103.2(b)(8)(i)-(ii)), and a missed deadline can lead to denial on the record or as abandoned. This repo does not compute case deadlines.
